messages.subject: [Picante-devel] picante 0.2-0 submitted to CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Just submitted picante 0.2-0 to CRAN. This version incorporates the  
new community phylogenetic structure metrics (PSR/PSV/PSC methods of  
Helmus et al.) and phylogenetic species richness accumulation curves  
written by Matt Helmus.

Steve
